title: RETRACTION: Enhanced Last Glacial aridity in the western Pampean plains inferred from southern South American loess
content:
Abstract

RETRACTION: Montecino Jara, D. A., Nogués, V., Cosentino, N. J., Torre, G., Coppo, R., Sawakuchi, A. O., et al. (2026). Enhanced Last Glacial aridity in the western Pampean plains inferred from southern South American loess. Paleoceanography and Paleoclimatology, 41, e2025PA005304. https://doi.org/10.1029/2025PA005304.

The above article, published online on 9 February 2026, in Wiley Online Library (wileyonlinelibrary.com), has been retracted by agreement between the authors; the journal Editor-in-Chief, Sarah Feakins; the American Geophysical Union; and Wiley Periodicals LLC. The retraction has been agreed upon following the authors' identification of inconsistencies in the calculation of parameters derived from grain-size distributions. This prompted the authors to revisit the original granulometric dataset and to reprocess the measurements, including a reanalysis of the full set of samples. The authors have revised the above article and its figures after recalculating parameters derived from grain-size distributions.

The new manuscript reflecting the corrected information is now republished here: https://doi.org/10.1029/2026PA005524.
